about: Hand-written sample table behind findings.md section 2. 22 donors from the Ethics Commission 2026 top-contributor tables and press. Class A = donor's own statement about a local-government issue at a stable URL; B = own statement of general (non-local) priorities, or first-party source seen only via a third party; C = third-party material only; D = nothing found. 'Nothing found' reflects a shallow search, not proof none exists.
